evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index sits at an exceptionally low score of 8 (Extreme Fear) as of 2022-06-14, declining from 11 the previous day. Both the 7-day mean (12.29) and 30-day mean (12.50) indicate deeply entrenched market distress. While single-digit sentiment extremes can theoretically set the stage for contrarian relief bounces, severe capitulatory momentum in crypto markets often drives continuation of selling pressure over short 24-hour horizons. limitations: Sentiment data is reported on a daily cadence and may lag intraday spot price shifts.
